latestVersion.changelog:
Online Pika AI Video Skill initial release.

- Instantly generate AI-powered videos from images or clips via a cloud rendering pipeline.
- Simple, prompt-based interface—no manual parameter tuning needed.
- Automatic session management with anonymous tokens (100 free credits) for first-time users.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 200MB.
- Easily export 1080p MP4 videos, check credits, and manage project timelines.
- Designed for TikTok, social creators, and anyone needing quick video content from static visuals.
